shape: some people feel like a cosy everyday comparison

slides.text: you feel like [[the blue cookie tin]] on the kitchen table: full of old buttons instead of sweets, but still the first thing i look for.

caption:
my grandmother still has the drawing i made at seven taped inside her pantry door.
she never remembers how to use the remote, but she remembers how i take my tea.
send this to the one who still watches you from the window until your car turns the corner.

#grandma #grandparents #grandmashouse
